conflict_resolver_policy.rule: If social says exploit but onchain has no anomaly, route WATCH or QUARANTINE, not CRITICAL_ALARM.
If onchain confirms abnormal LP/deployer/bridge/wallet behavior, raise severity.
Many social posts with same content are not multi-source confirmation unless independent source trust differs.
Speed cannot bypass source trust, duplicate filtering, and evidence requirement.

filter_routing_policy.condition: price-only comment, generic shill, no token/chain/wallet/contract/actionable entity
relevant but low severity, no immediate risk
single-source suspicious event or unknown_monitor without evidence
conflicting evidence, spam wave, low-trust source, possible manipulation
high-severity event with entity extraction and at least preliminary evidence
not produced by Gateway alone; requires Evidence/Prosecutor confirmation

fuzzy_duplicate_plan.critical_spam_guard: duplicate cluster cannot multiply CRITICAL alarms
fuzzy_duplicate_plan.threshold_policy: same entity + similar content + close time window = duplicate cluster

next_safe_step_contract_dryrun.name: HOT_INTELLIGENCE_INGRESS_GATEWAY_CONTRACT_DRYRUN_NOAPI
next_safe_step_contract_dryrun.scope: synthetic JSON events only; no API, no DB real apply, no runtime change
tests: synthetic LP pull with onchain confirmation

rate_limit_plan.route_level: max critical candidates per source/window planned

red_team_locked_rules.rule: Onchain evidence outranks social/news claims when conflict exists.
HOT Gateway cannot go live without conflict resolver policy.
CRITICAL event cannot become outbound alarm without Evidence/Prosecutor confirmation.
Unknown anomaly is not automatically dangerous; classify as UNKNOWN_MONITOR unless severity evidence exists.
Exact hash is not enough; content similarity/fuzzy duplicate threshold must be planned.
Source trust score must decay dynamically; recent major false signal has strong negative impact.
Source-level rate limiting is mandatory against spam wave attacks.
Do not copy every API parameter; keep only minimum decision-relevant fields.
Deep source registry details are deferred; only minimum source identity/trust fields now.
No Telegram token, Discord bot, X API, live API key, wallet, signing, trade, or paper trade in this stage.
